Title: Azure Backup is available in new Azure regions

Body.Content:
Azure Backup is now available in West India, as well as UAE Central, UAE North, South Africa North, and South Africa West.

With these expansions, Azure Backup is now available in all Azure regions.

For more information, see the Azure Backup technical documentation.
